categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zone-King Environmental Sci&Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in environmental protection services, focusing on environmental remediation, industrial pollution source treatment, and sales and services of environmental protection products. The main business segments include soil and groundwater remediation, water body restoration, industrial wastewater and waste gas treatment, solid waste disposal, and environmental equipment sales and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as high-concentration hexavalent chromium long-term stabilization, in-situ injection and cyclic extraction remediation, high-efficiency chemical oxidation with odor control for organic polluted soils, high-salinity and high-nitrogen industrial wastewater treatment, ECORs electro-catalytic oxidation, VOCs adsorption-desorption and solvent recovery, and sludge bio-leaching deep dehydration technology. It integrates multidisciplinary approaches including microbiology, chemistry, and engineering, and develops proprietary digital management platforms and intelligent environmental monitoring systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal governments, water utilities, engineering contractors, pharmaceutical, chemical, and emerging industries such as photovoltaic and lithium battery manufacturers. The company serves environmental remediation projects for industrial sites, water ecological restoration projects, and industrial pollution control projects, primarily in China. Major end markets are environmental governance and pollution control sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in the East China region, including Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Shandong, and Shanghai, with expanding presence in other regions such as Hubei, Chongqing, Guangdong, and Xinjiang. It has established a strong regional market base in Zhejiang and is actively developing projects in economically active provinces across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zone-King operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, providing integrated environmental remediation services, engineering procurement and construction (EPC), technical consulting, and operation and maintenance services. It also supplies environmental protection equipment and related after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive environmental solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven development with strategic focuses on resource recovery, digital intelligence, and equipment innovation. It invests heavily in R&D through its provincial enterprise research institute and collaborations with academic institutions. Key R&D directions include advanced soil and groundwater remediation, industrial wastewater and waste gas treatment, solid waste resource utilization, and smart environmental monitoring and management platforms. The company aims to enhance core technology barriers and expand into new application scenarios aligned with China's dual carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through EPC contracts for environmental remediation and pollution control projects, technical consulting services, and sales of environmental protection equipment. The company recognizes revenue based on contract progress for services rendered and upon delivery and acceptance for product sales. It also earns income from operation and maintenance contracts and technical service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private environmental remediation and industrial pollution control service provider in China, with strong technical capabilities and comprehensive service offerings. It competes with state-owned enterprises, regional environmental groups, and other private technology-driven firms. The industry is characterized by increasing competition, with national and local government-backed entities holding significant market shares, but Zhejiang Zone-King maintains competitive advantages through innovation and specialized expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 242.5 million, a 30% decrease from the previous year, reflecting industry-wide adjustment and cautious project acceptance. Net loss attributable to shareholders was RMB 82.2 million, an improvement compared to prior years. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 586 million, with equity of RMB 199 million. Despite recent financial challenges, the company continues to invest in R&D and expand its market footprint, aiming for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Zone-King differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies in complex soil and groundwater remediation, high-efficiency industrial wastewater and waste gas treatment, and integrated digital environmental management solutions. Its comprehensive one-stop service model, combining technical consulting, engineering, operation, and equipment supply, offers clients cost-effective, environmentally friendly, and technologically advanced solutions. The company emphasizes innovation, quality project execution, and strong after-sales service to build long-term client trust and industry reputation.
